recognize_zh: 乳房組織中一側為深染淋巴球浸潤，另一側為大片淡嗜酸性細胞（箭頭）；高倍下這些組織球的細胞質被嗜酸性、纖維狀／針狀結晶填滿，把細胞拉成梭形而核小且偏位，屬結晶儲積組織球增生症，提示伴隨單株免疫球蛋白分泌的淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A (low power): breast adipose tissue with a dense basophilic lymphoid infiltrate (upper right) merging into sheets of pale eosinophilic cells (arrows)
Panel B (high power): sheets of large histiocytes with abundant densely eosinophilic cytoplasm filled with elongated, needle-like/fibrillary crystalline inclusions
Histiocyte nuclei small, oval, bland and often displaced; cells appear spindled due to crystal packing
Scattered small lymphocytes and plasma cell-like cells between histiocytes
No mammary epithelial carcinoma is seen in these fields
describe_en: Section of breast tissue shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate adjacent to sheets of large pale eosinophilic cells infiltrating adipose tissue. At high power these cells are histiocytes whose abundant cytoplasm is distended by eosinophilic, needle-like and fibrillary crystalline inclusions, with small bland displaced nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells. The crystals typically represent intralysosomal monoclonal immunoglobulin (usually kappa). Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation (extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT type); CD68/CD163, light chain studies and B-cell markers are recommended.

ddx.vs: Granular cell tumor cells have coarse granular (not crystalline) cytoplasm and are S100/SOX10 positive and CD68 positive but not associated with a clonal lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate.
Muscle fibers show cross-striations and desmin/myogenin positivity rather than CD68-positive histiocytes filled with immunoglobulin crystals.
Fat necrosis histiocytes have foamy, clear vacuolated cytoplasm and lipid cysts, not dense eosinophilic crystalline cytoplasm.
Infectious histiocytoses show organisms on special stains or Michaelis-Gutmann bodies, whereas crystal-storing histiocytes contain light chain-restricted immunoglobulin crystals.
